title.en: ice rink at la défense, christmas market open.
title.de: eisbahn in la défense, weihnachtsmarkt offen.
title.tr: la défense'da buz pateni, noel pazarı açık.

line.en: the ice rink under the grande arche opens with the christmas market from 12 november to 3 january. the market is open 10:00 to 23:00 on saturday; check the rink's own hours before you go.
line.de: die eisbahn unter der grande arche ist mit dem weihnachtsmarkt vom 12. november bis 3. januar geöffnet. der markt hat samstags von 10:00 bis 23:00 offen; die eigenen zeiten der bahn vorher prüfen.
line.tr: grande arche'nin altındaki buz pateni, 12 kasım'dan 3 ocak'a kadar noel pazarıyla birlikte açık. pazar cumartesi 10:00 ile 23:00 arasında açık; gitmeden önce pistin kendi saatlerine bak.

sparks.why: Paris La Défense Christmas market with ice rink, 12 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027, market Saturday 10:00 to 23:00 (parisselectbook.com, onivapp.com); the rink's own hours were not confirmed.
